commands.author: clawsweeper[bot]
commands.review_summary:
The branch adds a GitHub Pages deployment workflow for the website, updates Vite/base-path deploy verification and public URL metadata, adds a CNAME and screenshot proof, and removes the Netlify/Vercel hosting configs.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: the new deploy workflow runs actions/configure-pages in a build job that only has contents: read, while configure-pages v6 calls repos.getPages before emitting base_path. I did not run a main-branch Pages deployment, so the live failure path is source-reproducible rather than fully reproduced.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A focused automated repair can address the configure-pages permission/API blocker, while maintainer approval remains required for the Pages-only hosting and DNS/HTTPS rollout.

target.title: ci: add GitHub Pages deploy workflow for website
target.body:
## Summary

- Publishes the `website/` app through GitHub Pages at the canonical public URL, `https://voxcli.sh`.
- Uses one Pages workflow with current action majors, deployment-only Pages/OIDC permissions, and manual recovery dispatch.
- Builds from the Pages-configured base path, so custom-domain `/` and repository fallback `/vox/` assets both resolve correctly.
- Fixes the preloader, favicon, canonical URL, and social-image paths; verifies the generated HTML, JS asset, and CNAME artifact.
- Removes the unused Netlify and Vercel deployment configurations so GitHub Pages is the single hosting contract.

## User impact

The merged Vox marketing site gains an owned deployment path and canonical URL instead of remaining only a buildable repository subproject. Changes under `website/` publish automatically after the deployment build, typecheck, and artifact checks pass.

## Hosting contract

- Canonical URL: `https://voxcli.sh`
- Publisher: GitHub Pages, using GitHub Actions
- Domain artifact: `website/public/CNAME`
- Base path: supplied by `actions/configure-pages`, not hardcoded
- Elevated permissions: `pages: write` and `id-token: write` on the deploy job only

## Proof

Exact head: `2e2f63651beda134f33b0f555af52741140a32d0`

- Root: frozen install, format/lint, typecheck, 61/61 tests, and production build pass.
- Website: frozen install and typecheck pass.
- Production builds for `/` and `/vox/` pass.
- Deploy verifier confirms favicon/assets, preloader logo, CNAME, canonical URL, and social metadata for both bases.
- `actionlint` passes for CI and deploy workflows.
- Structured Codex autoreview: clean; no accepted/actionable findings.
- Source-blind artifact checks return HTTP 200 for the `/vox/` page, logo, social image, CSS, JavaScript, and CNAME; refresh output is stable.
- Exact-head [GitHub CI](https://github.com/steipete/vox/actions/runs/28504401761) passes on Node 22, Node 24, website build/deploy verification, and GitGuardian.
- Repository Pages settings already use GitHub Actions with `voxcli.sh` as the custom domain.
- Live deployment proof is blocked only by public DNS: the apex still resolves to Namecheap URL forwarding, and HTTPS is unavailable.

## Required repository setup

Replace the current Namecheap URL-forwarding DNS with GitHub Pages apex A/AAAA records and `www` CNAME `steipete.github.io`. After propagation and certificate issuance, enable HTTPS and run live browser proof before merge unless that proof is explicitly waived.
